sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Monster Trucks Stunts is a driving game that requires skill, strategy, and a dash of luck to succeed. With a simple yet intuitive control scheme, players can commandeer their monster trucks and take on challenging levels across diverse landscapes. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of obstacles, including treacherous terrain, rival drivers, and treacherous jumps.

The game's core mechanics are built around performing stunts, with players earning points for successfully landing jumps, flips, and other death-defying maneuvers. With a wide range of customization options, players can personalize their ride to suit their style, from bold paint jobs to eye-catching decals.
